verdict: D11 COMPLETE - THE SPECTRAL-THEORY ISLAND ON THE FLAT TORUS IS PROVED KERNEL-CHECKED AND AXIOM-CLEAN: (1) FOURIER MODES e_k ARE EIGENFUNCTIONS OF THE FLAT LAPLACIAN WITH EIGENVALUES 4*pi^2*|k|^2 (EXPLICIT CHAIN-RULE COMPUTATION ON R^n AND ON THE TORUS); (2) PARSEVAL'S IDENTITY FOR FINITE-FOURIER-SUPPORT FUNCTIONS; (3) SUMMABILITY OF k -> (1+|k|^2)^(-sigma) OVER Z^n FOR sigma > n/2 (PROVED VIA THE 1-D Z SUMMABILITY, AN AM-GM COMPARISON AND THE p-SERIES); (4) SOBOLEV EMBEDDING ||u||_{C^0} <= C_s * ||u||_{H^s} FOR s > n/2 BY CAUCHY-SCHWARZ ON THE FOURIER COEFFICIENTS; (5) POINCARE INEQUALITY ||u||_2 <= (1/2*pi)*||grad u||_2 FOR MEAN-ZERO TRIGONOMETRIC POLYNOMIALS. ALL 15 AUDITED THEOREMS DEPEND ONLY ON [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; NO sorry, axiom, unsafe, native_decide OR proof_wanted; ALL 6 AUTHORED FILES COMPILE UNDER 'lake env lean <file>' (EXIT 0, 0 WARNINGS)
honesty_boundary: All statements are unconditional (no project axioms).

Parseval, the Sobolev embedding and the Poincare inequality are proved in the finite-Fourier-support (trigonometric polynomial) frame, exactly as scoped by the task ('Parseval's identity for finite Fourier support functions').

The Sobolev space H^s(T^n) is DEFINED for arbitrary L2 functions (subtype of L2 with summable weighted Fourier coefficients via mathlib's mFourierCoeff), but the extension of the embedding/Poincare inequalities from trigonometric polynomials to general H^s elements by density and completeness of the trigonometric system is NOT claimed.

The eigenvalue computation, the summability criterion and Parseval are fully general (all k, all n, all sigma > n/2) with no regularity hypotheses beyond the finiteness of the coefficient support where stated.

Only the 'if' direction of the sharp summability criterion is proved (sigma > n/2 implies summability); divergence on the coordinate axes for sigma <= n/2 is recorded in the doc comment but not formalized.

main_theorems: laplacian_fourierMode (k) (x) : laplacian (fourierMode k) x = (4 * pi^2 * normSq k) * fourierMode k x

trigPoly_parseval (c) : ||trigPolyL2 c|| ^ 2 = sum (k in c.support) ||c k|| ^ 2
summable_sobolevWeight_inv (hs : n/2 < sigma) : Summable (fun k : Fin n -> Z => (1 + normSq k) ^ (-sigma))
summable_sobolevWeightHalf_inv (hs : n < s) : Summable (fun k : Fin n -> Z => (1 + normSq k) ^ (-(s/2)))
